meta.name: android
meta.description: Builds, debugs, ships, and hardens Android apps: Gradle, Jetpack Compose, XML Views, ADB, and the Play release path. Use when a Gradle build fails or a dependency resolves to the wrong version, an APK will not install, or `adb` cannot see the device; when the app crashes, ANRs, leaks, or works on the emulator but not on a real phone; when Compose recomposes too much, state resets on rotation, or a list janks; when WorkManager never runs, an alarm is throttled, or a foreground service crashes at start; when a runtime permission is denied silently, scoped storage blocks a file, or Play rejects a declaration; when raising targetSdk changes behavior; when signing, R8 keep rules, bundle size, staged rollout, or Android vitals are the problem; also Room migrations, deep links, emulators, foldables, and CI builds. Not for Kotlin language mechanics (`kotlin`), store-listing ASO (`google-play-store`), or cross-platform frameworks (`flutter`, `react-native`).

copy.tagline: 调试和发布Android应用，解决崩溃与性能问题。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是Android开发者，需要处理构建错误、崩溃或发布问题。
copy.tagline_en: Debug and ship Android apps, fix crashes and performance issues.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're an Android developer dealing with build errors, crashes, or release issues.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你构建、调试、发布和加固 Android 应用，包括 Gradle、Jetpack Compose、XML 布局、ADB 和 Play 商店发布流程。它能诊断构建失败、安装拒绝、运行时崩溃、ANR、内存泄漏、性能问题、后台任务、权限问题、存储访问、Play 政策拒绝等。还能处理签名、R8 混淆、应用包体优化、分阶段发布、Android Vitals 等问题。
howto.when: 当 Gradle 构建失败、APK 无法安装、adb 无法识别设备、应用崩溃或 ANR、Compose 过度重组、WorkManager 不运行、权限被静默拒绝、Play 商店拒绝声明、targetSdk 升级导致行为变化、签名或 R8 规则问题、应用性能或 Vitals 问题、Room 迁移、深层链接、模拟器、折叠屏、CI 构建等场景触发。
